name: PR Overview shows the seeded derived intent with its confidence and sources
description: From the seeded repo's PR list, open PR #482 (Overview is the default tab) and confirm the Intent card: the seeded intent text, the Medium confidence badge, then expands the Sources disclosure to show the linked GitHub issue #471 as a used source and the external design link recorded as skipped. Nothing derives an intent, so no model call. Exercises GET /pulls/:id/intent and the Intent card.

cmd: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints
steps.label: open the PR row
navigate to the PR detail route
Intent card shows the confidence badge
scroll the sources disclosure into view (the brief card sits above the Intent card)
linked issue #471 is listed as a source
the external link is recorded as skipped with its reason
